newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE to list JGB futures spread contracts by end-98.
newsitem.headline: TSE to list JGB futures spread contracts by end-98.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange said on Tuesday that it would list 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures spread contracts by the end of calendar 1998.

The exchange said in a statement that four contracts will be traded at a time: the spread between the most nearby JGB futures contract and the second nearby JGB futures contract; the spread between the most nearby JGB futures contract and the third nearby JGB futures contract; the spread between the second nearby JGB futures contract and the third nearby JGB futures contract; and the spread between the second nearby JGB futures contract and the fourth nearby JGB futures contract.
One unit of trade is 100 million yen. The minimum price movement is 0.01 yen per 100 yen face value.
Trading hours are the same as those for JGB futures, the exchange said.
